subject: Lane B Draft PR #82 published; GPU claimed for final runtime gates
body: Lane B published Draft PR #82 from head fec4dee3dae2d76147cf9fa09e1db5d5a04852f4. Full exact-byte repository suite passed 626/626; focused Lane B/V10R2 suite passed 41/41 plus the additional Lane B training-contract tests. Lane B now claims the free RTX 3050 for fixed-shape FLA whole-model timing and a real nonpaged TorchAO8 optimizer-step qualification. Reserved rows/output remain unchanged; no Lane A namespace will be touched.
